name: All-Purpose Stir-Fry Sauce
steps: Whisk the cornstarch into the water until no lumps remain.
Add soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, grated garlic and ginger; whisk.
Stir-fry your protein and vegetables over high heat first.
Pour in the sauce and toss 1-2 min until it thickens and glosses.
notes: Enough for ~500 g of stir-fry. The cornstarch is what thickens it — add it to cold liquid first. Add chilli or rice vinegar to taste.
